tool_input.code:
const cmd = `
$path = 'D:\\Users\\jjq21\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\DeepSeek Harness\\resources\\app.asar'
$fs = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($path)
$br = New-Object System.IO.BinaryReader($fs)
$sz = $br.ReadUInt32(); $hs = $br.ReadUInt32()
$bytes = $br.ReadBytes([int]$hs)
$json = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
$fs.Close()
Write-Output ('dsh/package.json version field: ')
$idx = $json.IndexOf('"version":"')
Write-Output $json.Substring($idx, 40)
Write-Output '--- desktop app package.json (asar root) ---'
$idx2 = $json.IndexOf('"appId"')
if ($idx2 -gt 0) { Write-Output $json.Substring([Math]::Max(0,$idx2-400), 600) }
`;
const r = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Extract dsh version from asar header", command: cmd, timeoutMs: 60000 });
if (r.kind === "foreground") console.log(r.stdout.text.slice(0, 2000), "|ERR|", r.stderr.text.slice(0,500));
